human_review_required.evidence_points_out_of_10: Queries must actually support the reported values and attribution. Executing successfully or SELECTing constants is not sufficient.

verdict_points_out_of_20.criterion: Recognizes favorable pooled/time comparisons reverse under matched strata; candidate is worse in 8/8, not safer.
Explains the changing small/large mix and unequal build exposure; cites +3 pp standardized difference or +2/+4 pp stratum differences.
Treats candidate-associated regression as a hypothesis, not proven root cause; notes observational assignment/unmeasured confounding. No required invented alternative cause.

note: No automatic preferred-opinion score. Review factual criteria, uncertainty and evidence support; invalid schema prevents full credit but does not erase diagnostics.
